AI-01 · Intelligence

AI and machine learning development

Machine-learning prototypes, analytics and intelligent software integrated into real products.

Discuss your project

Useful AI starts with a clear question and the right data, not with a model. KT INDIA scopes the problem first, then builds machine-learning prototypes, analytics and intelligent features that fit into your software.

The team applies the same approach in its own product work: the ANNAVEDA personalisation engine is an in-house ML and recommendation-system research programme.

A good fit when

  • You have data but no clear way to use it.
  • You want to test whether an AI feature is worth building.
  • You need ML added to an existing product.

What this covers

  • ML prototypes
  • Data analysis and analytics
  • Recommendation systems
  • Intelligent software features
  • AI integration into existing products

Every project is scoped to the requirement. [Client to confirm typical deliverables, e.g. documentation, source code handover, support period.]

Process

How the work runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.
